cycle_identity: one ordered host event_msg.token_count snapshot containing info.total_token_usage
linkage_rule: thread.started.thread_id must equal exactly one transcript session_meta id/session_id
increment_rule: ordinal one equals first cumulative counter; later ordinals equal current minus previous cumulative counter
